research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Whatnot is researching systems and methods for sequencing items for sale in a live video event and intelligent bundling of items from a live platform to manage item distribution. It develops item repacking interfaces and digital transfer techniques, digital item management and randomization techniques in an online platform, and systems and methods for asynchronous interaction with time-limited social image posts, automated images in a live video event, preventing unwanted interactions in a live stream event, and reduced latency in a scalable, multi user publish subscribe framework. These efforts span live commerce workflows, content tools, safety, and infrastructure.

overview_description.description:
Whatnot is a live shopping marketplace that connects buyers and sellers through interactive livestreams, auctions, and online storefronts. The company provides a platform where sellers can host live shows, demonstrate products, conduct auctions, offer fixed-price listings, and engage with buyers in real time across categories including fashion, collectibles, electronics, beauty, and other consumer goods. Its platform also supports product discovery, payments, shipping, seller tools, giveaways, messaging, and live analytics to facilitate transactions and manage online commerce.

Whatnot combines livestreaming, social interaction, and e-commerce to create an interactive shopping experience in which buyers can communicate directly with sellers while viewing and purchasing products. The company also provides businesses and individual sellers with digital tools to manage inventory, schedule shows, process orders, and build communities around their products and interests.
